import os
import warnings
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from lightgbm import LGBMClassifier

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Set environment variables to minimize overhead
os.environ["OMP_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"
os.environ["MKL_NUM_THREADS"] = "1"

# Define paths based on instructions
INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"

# Path constants
TRAIN_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train.csv")
TEST_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test.csv")
SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH = os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv")
SUBMISSION_FILE = os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv")

# Load Data
df_train = pd.read_csv(TRAIN_PATH)
df_test = pd.read_csv(TEST_PATH)
sample_submission = pd.read_csv(SAMPLE_SUBMISSION_PATH)  # Use template for format

# Identify columns
target_column = "target"

# Handle special cases: exclude f_27 (high cardinality categorical) and id column
feature_columns = [
    col
    for col in df_train.columns
    if col != "id" and col != target_column and col != "f_27"
]

# Prepare Feature Matrices
X_train_full = df_train[feature_columns].copy()
y_train_full = df_train[target_column].values
X_test = df_test[feature_columns].copy()

# Split Training Data into Train and Validation Sets
# Keep stratification for class balance, validate on true holdout
X_train, X_val, y_train, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train_full, test_size=0.20, random_state=42, stratify=y_train_full
)

# Initialize LightGBM Classifier
model = LGBMClassifier(
    n_estimators=1000,
    learning_rate=0.05,
    num_leaves=63,
    subsample=0.8,
    colsample_bytree=0.8,
    min_child_samples=20,
    reg_alpha=0.0,
    reg_lambda=0.1,
    random_state=42,
    force_col_wise=True,
    verbose=-1,
)

# Fix: Remove invalid early_stopping parameter or use correct syntax
# Simple fit without callbacks avoids the TypeError completely
history = model.fit(
    X_train,
    y_train,
    eval_set=[(X_val, y_val)],
    eval_metric="binary_logloss",
    verbose=-1,
    cat_boost=True,
)

# Evaluate on Hold-Out Validation Set (genuine hold-out, NOT refitted)
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]
validation_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC Score: {validation_auc:.4f}")

# Generate Predictions on Test Set (never touched during training)
test_probs = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Ensure test IDs match sample_submission format
test_ids = df_test["id"].values.astype(str).tolist()

# Prepare Submission File
submission_data = pd.DataFrame({"id": test_ids, "target": test_probs.round(6)})
submission_data.to_csv(SUBMISSION_FILE, index=False)

print(f"Submission file saved to {SUBMISSION_FILE}")
print(f"Total samples: {len(submission_data)}")
print(f"AUC-ROC Score on hold-out validation: {validation_auc:.6f}")
